parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: Configuration ID. You can call the [ListHttpRequestHeaderModificationRules](~~2867483~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

parameters.name: RequestHeaderModification
parameters.description: Modify request headers. Three operation methods are supported: add, delete, and modify.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description:
Operation method. Valid values:

- add: Add.
- del: Delete.
- modify: Modify.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
Value type. Valid values:
- static: Static mode.
- dynamic: Dynamic mode.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content. Use conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq "video.example.com").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: Rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
